s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent painful skin lesions with ulceration and systemic inflammation
salient_findings: Painful pimple-like bumps on bilateral lower legs
Ulcers with central eschars and dusky gray borders
key_facts: Patient is a young black woman
Presented with chills and bilateral lower extremity swelling
Recent course of trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole for methicillin-sensitive Staphylococcus aureus
Medical history includes treatment with methimazole and atenolol
Laboratory tests show elevated CRP and ESR
ANA titer 1:80
P-ANCA titer 1:20
Anti-myeloperoxidase (MPO) titer 141 U
Anti-SSA/Ro antibodies level 120 U
Pathology shows mid- and deep dermal lymphohistiocytic infiltrate with neutrophils
Special stains negative for organisms

raw.syndrome_frame: Recurrent painful skin lesions with ulceration and systemic inflammation
salient_findings: Painful pimple-like bumps on bilateral lower legs
Ulcers with central eschars and dusky gray borders
key_facts: Patient is a young black woman
Presented with chills and bilateral lower extremity swelling
Recent course of trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole for methicillin-sensitive Staphylococcus aureus
Medical history includes treatment with methimazole and atenolol
Laboratory tests show elevated CRP and ESR
ANA titer 1:80
P-ANCA titer 1:20
Anti-myeloperoxidase (MPO) titer 141 U
Anti-SSA/Ro antibodies level 120 U
Pathology shows mid- and deep dermal lymphohistiocytic infiltrate with neutrophils
Special stains negative for organisms

differentials: Neutrophilic dermatosis of the dorsal hands
per_call: Neutrophilic dermatosis of the dorsal hands

shortlist.label: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated ANCA titer and presence of systemic inflammation

shortlist.label: Microscopic polyangiitis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated MPO titer and presence of renal and skin involvement

shortlist.label: Erythema elevatum diutinum
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of painful skin lesions and systemic inflammation

shortlist.label: Leukocytoclastic vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of skin lesions with neutrophilic infiltrate and vasculitis

shortlist.label: Cutaneous small-vessel vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of skin lesions with vasculitis and elevated ANCA titer

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with painful lesions, chills, and bilateral lower extremity swelling, along with laboratory tests showing elevated CRP and ESR, and pathology revealing mid- and deep dermal lymphohistiocytic infiltrate with neutrophils, is most consistent with cutaneous small-vessel vasculitis. The presence of ANA, P-ANCA, and anti-myeloperoxidase antibodies also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
rejected.why: Lack of granulomatous inflammation on pathology

rejected.label: Microscopic polyangiitis
rejected.why: Absence of renal involvement and lack of granulomatous inflammation

rejected.label: Erythema elevatum diutinum
rejected.why: Clinical presentation and pathology do not match this rare condition

rejected.label: Leukocytoclastic vasculitis
rejected.why: While some features are present, the overall clinical and pathological picture is more consistent with cutaneous small-vessel vasculitis
